critical_rules: The six knowledge areas and 30 business analysis task descriptions have not been changed.
Certification candidates should reference the BABOK Guide and appropriate Certification Handbooks for detailed information.
Tasks may be sequential, iterative, simultaneous/concurrent, reviewed or repeated; there is no universal prescribed task order.
principles: Analyze to determine what is valuable
requirement_types: Solution requirements - non-functional / quality of service
rules_for_rosine: Use the Standard for mindset, foundations, principles and practical task-card framing.
Use BABOK v3 for detailed task structure and certification task names.
Do not infer current exam scope from a Standard task-card footer; the current blueprint/handbook controls exam scope.
Do not teach a universal BABOK task sequence.
